text:
Italy coach Roberto Mancini predicts Roma will win the Scudetto this season, but feels Serie A clubs have ‘no interest’ in the national team and stresses that Nicolò Zaniolo ‘should be a star of Italian football.’
During his interview, Mancini spoke about Italy’s last two games, ending in a 3-1 win over France and a 4-1 loss to Belgium.
“We were a little too casual in certain defensive situations,” he said.
“I think the two defeats against Belgium will prove more important and formative than the two matches against France.”
Italy failed to qualify for the last three editions of the World Cup, yet Mancini believes the Azzurri should always aim to win the trophy.
“You can’t try to achieve something unless you believe in it wholeheartedly,” he insisted.
The Azzurri boss also criticised Serie A clubs, saying they are not interested in developing the national team.
“Clubs have no interest in the national team, which has to find its own solutions,” he argued.
“There’s no point complaining about the situation that’s been developing for at least twenty years. We just have to find the players and give them experience, even if that means risking a few defeats.”
The CT also predicted the 2026-27 Serie A winner: “I think Roma [will win]. Inter are the best team. I had a lot of faith in Napoli at the start, but they’ve had too many injuries. As for Lazio, I’ll say this: don’t bet on them collapsing.”
Last but not least, Mancini also spoke about individual players, especially Udinese’s Zaniolo.
“I won’t go too far back. I think Zaniolo has great potential,” Mancini noted.
“When I called him up to the national team, at his first training session he looked like a boy playing with the grown-ups; by the third, he looked like a grown-up playing with the grown-ups. Given his physical and technical qualities, he should be a star of Italian football today.
“I call up whoever is playing well when selections are being made; whoever can contribute to the team. Nico has always behaved properly with me, despite the personal problems he’s had. I hope he does everything he can to come back.”
Mancini has called up Zaniolo twice since returning as the Azzurri coach, but the attacker withdrew twice, first because of an injury and then due to personal issues.
digest_he:
רוברטו מאנצ'יני, מאמן נבחרת איטליה לשעבר, הביע את הערכתו כי רומא תזכה באליפות סרייה א בעונת 2026-2027, וציין כי אינטר היא הקבוצה הטובה ביותר כיום. מאנצ'יני התייחס למשחקי הנבחרת האחרונים והביע ביקורת כלפי מועדוני הליגה שלטענתו אינם מביעים עניין אמיתי בפיתוח הכדורגל הלאומי ומציאת פתרונות לדור העתיד.

בנוסף, מאנצ'יני החמיא לשחקן אודינזה ניקולו זאניולו, וציין כי בשל כישרונו הפיזי והטכני הוא היה אמור להיות כוכב מרכזי בכדורגל האיטלקי כיום. המאמן הדגיש כי למרות בעיות אישיות שחווה השחקן, הוא מקווה שישוב להציג את יכולתו הגבוהה ויתרום לנבחרת.
